title: Stand-on vessel receives a justified avoidance request

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is BRAVO. REQUEST. Please alter your course to starboard. I have CHARLIE close on my starboard side and cannot safely alter to starboard. Over.
events.expected_response: Verify BRAVO and CHARLIE against the tracked traffic, acknowledge the request, and make the requested starboard alteration only if the complete observed geometry remains safe.
events.forbidden_outcome: Blind compliance without checking that the starboard alteration is safe across both BRAVO and CHARLIE.
